cases.case_label: Germline AluY in DICER1 RNase IIIa domain
cases.mechanism_detail: A germline AluY insertion within the RNase IIIa domain coding region of DICER1, present in blood, normal tissue and tumours and confirmed by nanopore sequencing, is predicted to disrupt DICER1 function.
cases.quote: Subsequent long-read nanopore sequencing confirmed a pathogenic AluY insertion, predicted to disrupt DICER1 function.
